description: All the code one request needs, from endpoint to data access, kept together by feature instead of being spread across technical layers.
`MapGroup` creates a `RouteGroupBuilder` that applies a shared prefix and metadata such as tags or authorization to every endpoint mapped on it.
One deployable application split into business modules that own their data and talk to each other only through public contracts.
A small public project, such as `Inventory.Contracts`, holding the only interfaces and DTOs other modules are allowed to reference.

Each module maps its tables to its own database schema, with its own migrations history table, so ownership is visible and a cross-module join stands out in review; only separate database roles and grants stop another module from querying them.
An assembly attribute that lets a named assembly, typically the module's test project, see `internal` types without making them public.
